name: _Navigation Item
description: Private native destination-link renderer used only by Sidebar. It owns icon/label presentation, expanded/compact geometry, current-location styling, and browser-derived hover/focus/pressed states while Sidebar owns grouping, order, and the single current-route invariant.

props.name: label
props.description: Required non-empty destination name. It is visible in expanded mode and retained for assistive technology in compact mode.

props.name: href
props.description: Required non-empty native anchor destination supplied by the parent item data.

props.name: icon
props.description: Required compatible 20px icon content. The implementation expects an icon that can inherit currentColor so semantic foreground changes remain governed.

props.name: mode
props.description: Private presentation mode supplied by Sidebar; not independently consumer-configurable.

props.name: current
props.description: Private current-location boolean derived by Sidebar from currentId; maps to aria-current and selected presentation.

representations.mapsTo: Sidebar currentId equality passed to internalApi.current

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Native anchor that owns destination activation, accessible name, current-location semantics, and focusability.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Inline icon-plus-label content in expanded mode and centered icon-only visible presentation in compact mode.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: 20px compatible destination icon that remains visible in both modes.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Destination text visible in expanded mode and visually hidden but accessibility-retained in compact mode.

states.name: current
states.description: Current-location presentation derives from Sidebar currentId and is exposed semantically through aria-current=page.

states.name: hover
states.description: Hover presentation is browser/CSS-derived and does not change the current route.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Visible focus presentation derives from native anchor focus-visible and remains independent from current-route styling.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Pressed presentation derives from native anchor active interaction and does not mutate current-route state.

semantics.accessibleName: The required non-empty destination label names the link in both expanded and compact modes.
semantics.keyboardActivation: Native anchor keyboard activation; no custom key handler or roving tabindex.
semantics.focus: The native anchor remains the focusable element and receives the governed 2px focus-visible ring independently from selected/current presentation.
requirements: The implementation uses a native anchor link as the semantic and focusable destination control.
When current is true the anchor exposes aria-current=page; non-current items omit aria-current.
Compact presentation hides only the visible label while retaining the same accessible destination name for assistive technology.
Focus-visible remains visually distinct from current-route selection and uses the semantic focus/default color with the governed strong focus border width.
Hover and pressed presentation are CSS-derived browser interaction states and never change which route is current.
Expanded source geometry is 184 by 40 CSS pixels with 12px logical-start and 10px logical-end padding; its icon-to-label content gap is 12px.
Compact source geometry is 44 by 44 CSS pixels with 12px padding on every side.
The destination icon is 20px by 20px in both modes and uses currentColor-compatible rendering so foreground semantics can follow item state.
Default non-current expanded text uses semantic fg/secondary; hover, focus, pressed, and current expanded text use fg/primary as authored in Figma.
Selected/current and pressed backgrounds use semantic state/selected; non-current hover uses semantic state/hover.
The private helper never appears in the public React package barrel, package exports map, or supported deep-import surface.

content.description: Private governed destination anatomy supplied only by Sidebar item data.
